data.short_description: Binchotan is a new all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ concept specializing in pork, owned by Sean Liang, planned for the Historic Commercial Center District at 953 E Sahara Ave, Ste. data.short_description: Slava Cafe & Bakery is a new Ukrainian-inspired café and bakery from owner and chef Svitlana Eadie, set to open at 37 Wall St. in downtown Asheville. The café will serve breakfast and lunch Wednesday through Sunday, offering cabbage rolls, Ukrainian potato pancakes, crepes, fresh breads, pastries, desserts, coffee, espresso, and specialty drinks such as kvas. The space is a former coffee shop along Wall Street, and Eadie plans to continue operating her catering company, Svitlana's Kitchen, after the café opens.

data.short_description: Portland Spirit is planning to open a full-service, casual, family-friendly restaurant inside the historic Rose Building at Tom McCall Waterfront Park.
